text:
inc-bot: ALERT: spike in 5xx errors for hosted customers -> suspected capacity-tier routing to dedicated pools. auto-pager sent to #incidents and oncall. prob: wrong tenant selector, pool ded-prod-eu-7 showing unexpected traffic.

sara_ops: seeing 502s from the hosted API gateway around 16:12 UTC. traffic that should hit hosted-frontend is landing in ded-prod-eu-7 and failing auth.

henry_oncall: oncall here, taking it. markers: increased latency and 5xx across multiple hosted tenants, error message = "tenant not bound to pool" in ded pool logs.

mike_sre: logs confirm headers had X-Tier=hosted but route matched dedicated. suspect recent rollout: routing policy "tier-blend-v2" pushed 16:05 UTC.

lina_se: can you pull the policy diff? I saw a change to tenant_selector regex.

mike_sre: diff excerpt:
```
- tenant_selector: "^acct-.*$"
+ tenant_selector: "^acct-.*|.*-trial$"  # accidentally too broad
```

henry_oncall: ugh, that `.*-trial` sucks. that includes hosted trial tenants that should stay in hosted. initiating rollback of tier-blend-v2.

henry_oncall: ACTIONS: 1) rollback policy 2) toggle route to force hosted routing 3) drain ded-prod-eu-7 for affected tenant ids 4) notify customers. Doing 1 now.

sara_ops: +1, pushing rollback command: `redwood routing policy rollback --id tier-blend-v2 --who henry_oncall`

inc-bot: POLICY_ROLLBACK: tier-blend-v2 rollback initiated by henry_oncall at 16:19:02 UTC.

mike_sre: rollback accepted, new active policy = tier-blend-v1. Observed immediate drop in misrouted requests. Error rate falling from 18% -> 4% in 2min.

henry_oncall: doing controlled route toggle for ded-prod-eu-7 to drop sticky sessions: `routing control set --pool ded-prod-eu-7 --accept false`

carol_support: fielding customer messages. ACME reported 502s around 16:10 UTC, now reporting partial recovery. estimating ~12 hosted tenants saw elevated errors for ~9 minutes.

product_tim: are any high-SLA customers still impacted? need comms if >1 big customer.

sara_ops: ACME and BetaCorp were the largest. ACME saw 20% of their requests fail, BetaCorp ~7%. both trending down.

lina_se: can we revoke any stuck sessions or tokens that may have authenticated against ded?

mike_sre: yes, we'll invalidate pool-level session keys for ded-prod-eu-7 and sweep KV cache for impacted tenant ids. running `infra auth revoke --scope pool:ded-prod-eu-7 --reason "misroute containment"`

inc-bot: JOB_STARTED: auth revoke on ded-prod-eu-7.

henry_oncall: containment looks good. traffic normalized to hosted path. post-mortem checklist: - root cause, - timeline, - rollback process improvement, - gating for tenant_selector changes. assigning owner.

product_tim: assign follow-up to lina_se + mike_sre to ship a policy validation test. cust comm: send proactive note to ACME + BetaCorp with summary and ETA for RCA.

lina_se: I'll own the validation test and PR. creating patch: add explicit whitelist for dedicated tenant prefixes and unit tests against tenant_selector regex.

mike_sre: I'll open an infra hotfix to prevent regex expansions in routing policies without schema-level approval. linking incident ticket.

carol_support: drafting customer note. will include timeline and mitigation steps. will request legal review for wording.

henry_oncall: interim mitigation: add CI gate to reject regex changes unless run against staging sample of tenant ids. Also add a canary window for routing policy rollouts.

inc-bot: INCIDENT: severity=sev2, start=2187654321, mitigation=policy rollback + pool toggle, status=stabilized.

henry_oncall: final status: traffic recovered, errors returned to baseline. Recommend postmortem and two follow-ups: (1) policy CI gate (owner=mike_sre) (2) tenant_selector linting + testdata (owner=lina_se).

sara_ops: timeline note: root alert 16:12, rollback 16:19, pool toggle 16:21, auth revoke 16:24, stabilized 16:27. total customer impact window ~15m.

mike_sre: quick blurb for RCA: accidental regex expansion in tier-blend-v2 allowed hosted trial tenants to match dedicated selector, causing auth mismatch and 5xx. Fix: tighten selector and add CI tests.

product_tim: will prepare comms to larger customer list + blog post on routing safety improvements.

henry_oncall: handing off to oncall follow-up. anyone else? otherwise I'll mark incident mitigated and create postmortem draft.

carol_support: no further customer escalations at the moment. I'll keep monitoring for 24h and update if anything pops up.

lina_se: created PR #4523 for selector fix and testcases. linking in incident doc.

mike_sre: opened infra ticket INF-981: require schema for tenant_selector and add canary rollout safeguard.

henry_oncall: thanks everyone. incident mitigated. postmortem owner = henry_oncall, follow-ups assigned. :white_check_mark:
